assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A missing placement, a position other than 1 or a fallback reason fails; this ensures counters did not silently exercise an unavailable roadmap.
A missing first build or a second unchanged build changes the independently observed builder-call list; disabling cache reuse reddens line 80.
Placement output changes across an unchanged call or mtime-only touch; the earlier output is an invariance reference, not an input supplied to the code.
Omitting named-plan identity from invalidation prevents the second builder entry; always rebuilding causes a third entry.

A missing initial build, changed placement, failure to invalidate either index or failure to cache the rebuilt result fails the corresponding assertion; reverting index tracking reddens line 102 (line 101 in the earlier recorded base test).

Failure to observe a nonqueued-plan touch leaves only one builder entry; reverting additional plan identities reddens line 117 (the same assertion appears at line 116 in the earlier negative-control test revision).
Failure to observe plan arrival leaves one build, or failure to observe removal leaves two; reverting directory membership tracking reddens line 128.
A figure write changes the placements or triggers a second build; broadening signature invalidation to unrelated directories fails this case.
The counter must first observe the known plan directory; always listing unchanged plan or sprint directories then makes the nonempty second listing fail line 162.

assertion_input_tethers: None: call-count expectations are independent observations, and output-to-prior-output checks assert invariance rather than echoing an input passed to production.
